rationale: Additive/migration verbs ('upgrade', 'retiro', 'adoptar'); named entities: google-genai, GoogleModel, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash, Gemini 4 Argon, parrot.conf, parrot.bots. FEAT-688 (merged PR #1685) already added Argon and raised the SDK floor, so the plan centres on (a) what 2.5 references still exist and where, (b) what the current pin is, (c) how defaults are centralised after FEAT-796.

queries.intent: Precedent: read the approved FEAT-688 gemini-upgrade spec to learn what already landed (Argon member, routing gates, SDK floor) and what it explicitly left for later (2.5 retirement?).
Precedent: FEAT-688 finding on enum members that are load-bearing by name — tells us which 2.5 members cannot be deleted without AttributeError.
Precedent: FEAT-688 finding on enum consumers and the public /models HTTP surface.
Earlier spec that centralised the Google default model — learn the single source of truth for the Google default and whether it still names gemini-2.5-flash.
Per-component LLM defaults module (FEAT-796) — how DEFAULT_LLM / component vars resolve, and which Google ids are hardcoded as fallbacks.
User-facing docs for per-component defaults — which Gemini ids are documented as defaults (docs must change too).
Task record of the last google-genai floor alignment — current declared floor and the introspection procedure to reuse for the next bump.
Orient: which modules reference the 2.5 enum members or ids according to the graph (consumers outside the client package).
Orient: pre-built agents under parrot.bots and which llm/model defaults they declare.

params.question: pre-built agent class default llm model google gemini parrot.bots

queries.intent: Inventory every literal gemini-2.5 id across the source and test trees of all distributions (the retirement blast radius).
Inventory every by-name reference to the 2.5 enum members (deleting a member referenced by name is an import-time AttributeError).
Read the GoogleModel / VertexAIModel catalogue: list the 2.5 members, their aliases, and the Gemini 4 Argon members as they stand today.
Routing gates in the Google client: prefix whitelists (_requires_thinking, _default_combined_call_prefixes, _is_gemini3_model, computer-use) and any hardcoded gemini-2.5 default model.
parrot.conf: every Google/Gemini-related setting and its default value (the 'default in parrot.conf' the request names).
Pre-built agents in parrot.bots: every hardcoded llm= / model= / 'google:' default (the 'agentes pre-hechos' the request names).
Current google-genai pins across every workspace pyproject (floor to raise) and the lock-resolved version.
Read llm_defaults.py in full — the resolver that parrot.conf and every component go through after FEAT-796; the real 'default' that must stop being 2.5.
Gemini ids outside packages/: settings templates, env examples, docs, examples, plugins and agent YAML/TOML definitions that pin gemini-2.5 as a default.

params.path: docs/ examples/ settings/ env/ plugins/ sdd/config.json .github/

queries.intent: Current Gemini 4 / Argon surface: enum members, prefix gates, tests and pricing rows that already know about 4.x (what the 2.5 retirement can point to).
Pricing / cost tables: rows for gemini-2.5-* and gemini-4-* in the bundled pricing JSON (CostCalculator already warns the google table is stale).
Tests that assert on the 2.5 members or ids (the catalogue tests FEAT-688 edited) — they must be updated with the enum.
Public HTTP /models surface that enumerates GoogleModel — confirm it still publishes 2.5 ids.
Voice / live paths: gemini-2.5-flash-live, native-audio and TTS ids used by GoogleLive / voice integrations (a 2.5 retirement may or may not include them).
Gemini ids in the embeddings satellite (google embeddings / document-understanding paths) that may pin 2.5.
Model deprecation sweep precedent (FEAT-719): how deprecated ids were handled last time (deprecated_models map vs pure deletion).
Recent history of the GoogleModel catalogue — FEAT-688 / FEAT-781 shape of the last edits.
Recent history of the Google client routing gates.
Recent history of the default-model plumbing (conf.py + llm_defaults.py) — FEAT-796 landed days ago.
Commits mentioning gemini / google-genai in the last 90 days across the repo — merged PRs #1685 (FEAT-688), #1773 (FEAT-719), #1890 (FEAT-781).
History of the google-genai pin bumps (which versions the floor has been at, and when).

expected_findings: What FEAT-688 already delivered (Argon member, gates, floor) and the current google-genai floor + lock version
Complete inventory of gemini-2.5 ids and GEMINI_2_5_* member references across src, tests, docs, examples, settings
The single source of truth for the Google default model after FEAT-796 (llm_defaults.py / conf.py) and its current value
Pre-built agents in parrot.bots that hardcode a Gemini id
Routing-gate prefixes in client.py that mention 2.5 (thinking gate) and the 4.x whitelist
Public surfaces (HTTP /models, pricing table, docs) that will change
Voice/live/TTS 2.5 ids that may be outside the deprecation
